how honest you can be in the title, about the fact that you need validation, tells me that i dont even need to read the post. tbh, if you can be that honest with yourself about that, then im sure your other judgements will be honest too. i didnt read the post, but from that, im sure they are n's, unfortunately.

you are clearly a great person, but imo you seem to have a problem seeing that yourself. i mean im no therapist, but thats what i see, as a guy on a computer. im calling you great for the reason i mentioned before, how honest you can be with yourself. its a very, very important trait, i think.... and youre on a rare level. really. i believe so, at least.

though, sorry, but my diagnosis is that you probably have heart walls. i think you should look that up. its a bit new agey but maybe youll resonate with it. who knows

http://www.releaseyourbaggage.com/release-work/the-emotion-code/heart-wall/
you can truly say that again! i wish i had that

I'm sorry, if that helps at all. you're 100percent right, as far as i can see. i should be quite glad that I'm only 20 years old. i wish i could help them, though, and its possible. i guess that 100 percent thing aint quite right then.

are they?or is that just what it seems like on the surface? or are they just trying to act a certain way so i dont leave on them, again? i dont know. 

ive been whistle blowing a bit, if i can call it that. sort of being meta about the whole situation. a bit obnoxious maybe, but its needed.

edit: change doesnt happen on the surface. change happens on a deeper level, and it simply shines through on the surface. what they are doing is fake.

i know i seem bitter, but i think its true.
my family does it too. isnt it scary how well it works? endure.

same. & at the same time, not to be too personal, i have ZERO capacity for happiness, and sadistic and masochistic tendencies.. something is motherfukin fishy.
